game_concept: A tower defense set in The Kingdom – Market Square, a bustling cobbled market square: the royal scribe must handle thieves while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Swap Switch: Swap two variables with a temporary slot to reroute scrolls without losing either value.
theme: The Kingdom – Market Square: a bustling cobbled market square
core_gameplay_loop: In Market Square, repeat each round: Swap two variables with a temporary slot to reroute scrolls without losing either value. Each round, thieves strike the wall banner, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the a value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the wall banner from thieves in Market Square: keep the a meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 30-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: a drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 30-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 1 (intro tier): Swap Switch
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Swap Switch' (Week 1 slot 4), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Market Square'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
